overall.summary: The revision did what round 1 asked, and more. One precedence order (B-37) is stated word for word in all five headers. B-34 to B-36 and the round's new rulings (B-37 to B-44) are written into the domain page tables. The eight stale sentences are gone, and the drawn board that contradicted a ruling is corrected. B-36's expired request is now one of the best-specified states in the area: page, badge, actions, emails, tokens, support queue and job. Page alerts focus a labelled and described container. The time-limit warning is drawn and measured. One code-screen grammar fixes Tab order on Verify, R4 and P6, and the 390-only drawers put the commit first in the DOM. The rig still finds 0 blockers and 0 majors across 84 boards × 10 viewports × light and forced-dark, and the frame hasn't moved. R-C rises from 7.9 to 8.6, and all 23 units Ship. What keeps the set at 8.6 rather than 8.8: Part A lags its own round in six places (CC-N1), B-43's selector misses R1, two should-fix states (S-C's busy row, E4's other routes) are still copy-only, the handoff grew to 4,639 lines, and canvas wiring and three board heights are small debts. None is a must-fix.
